knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A certificate is not a licence or authority. The Australian requirement must be checked before any treatment work.
The licence advice describes US local government. Australian requirements must be checked.
Chemicals are separated, secured and kept away from fuel and people. The Australian rules must be checked.

practicalCriteria: Readiness list is completed with each equipment item, vehicle, storage and paperwork item present or marked outstanding
Each US guide step is marked applicable or not applicable, with a reason
The learner states that a certificate is not a licence and names the person responsible for confirming each regulatory item
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Source and date for each regulatory check
stopWorkCriteria: Pool treatment work started on the basis of a certificate or a US licence rule
Chemicals carried or stored with fuel or in the cabin
A regulatory item marked as confirmed without a source
